command:# Reports live under temporary-docs/gnomish/<task>/: the task branch's name without its
# gnomish/ prefix (the factory's own sanitized taskId), 'local' off a task branch.
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
resolution=$dir/fix-artifacts.md
if [ ! -f "$resolution" ]; then
  echo "no resolution record at $resolution - write it before finishing the round, see .gnomish/stages/fix-artifacts/instructions.md"
  exit 1
fi

command:# Reports live under temporary-docs/gnomish/<task>/: the task branch's name without its
# gnomish/ prefix (the factory's own sanitized taskId), 'local' off a task branch.
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
review=$dir/review-artifacts.md
resolution=$dir/fix-artifacts.md
change=$(sed -n 's/^Change:[[:space:]]*//p' $dir/change.md | head -1)
named=$(sed -n 's/^## Review Resolution:[[:space:]]*//p' "$resolution" | head -1 | tr -d '`')
if [ "$named" != "$change" ]; then
  echo "the resolution's '## Review Resolution:' heading names '$named', but this task's change is '$change'"
  exit 1
fi
wanted=$(awk 'index($0, "### Recommendations, ordered") == 1 { inside = 1; next } /^##/ { inside = 0 } inside' "$review" \
  | sed -nE 's/^([0-9]+)\. \*\*.*/\1/p' | sort -n)
got=$(sed -nE 's/^### ([0-9]+) — (applied|rejected)[[:space:]]*$/\1/p' "$resolution" | sort -n)
duplicates=$(printf '%s\n' "$got" | uniq -d)
[ -z "$duplicates" ] || { echo "$duplicates"; echo "each recommendation is resolved exactly once - these numbers have two entries"; exit 1; }
if [ "$wanted" != "$got" ]; then
  echo "the review has recommendations: $(echo $wanted)"
  echo "the resolution resolves:        $(echo $got)"
  echo "give every recommendation of the review one '### <N> — applied' or '### <N> — rejected' entry, in the review's numbering"
  exit 1
fi
entries() { awk -v state="$1" '/^### [0-9]+ — / { inside = ($0 ~ (" — " state "[[:space:]]*$")) ; next } /^##/ { inside = 0 } inside' "$resolution"; }
applied=$(grep -cE '^### [0-9]+ — applied' "$resolution" || true)
rejected=$(grep -cE '^### [0-9]+ — rejected' "$resolution" || true)
for field in Recommendation Re-verified Edit; do
  count=$(entries applied | grep -cE "^- $field: " || true)
  [ "$count" = "$applied" ] || { echo "$applied applied entr(ies) but $count '- $field:' line(s) - every applied entry names the recommendation, what you re-verified, and the edit you made"; exit 1; }
done
for field in Recommendation Re-verified Evidence; do
  count=$(entries rejected | grep -cE "^- $field: " || true)
  [ "$count" = "$rejected" ] || { echo "$rejected rejected entr(ies) but $count '- $field:' line(s) - every rejected entry names the recommendation, what you re-verified, and the evidence it fails on"; exit 1; }
done

command:# Reports live under temporary-docs/gnomish/<task>/: the task branch's name without its
# gnomish/ prefix (the factory's own sanitized taskId), 'local' off a task branch.
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
change=$(sed -n 's/^Change:[[:space:]]*//p' $dir/change.md | head -1)
if ! out=$(openspec validate "$change" --strict 2>&1); then
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -20
  echo "openspec validate $change --strict must pass before the round ends - fix the errors above in the change's own artifacts; if one needs a decision rather than a faithful restatement, escalate through \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE"
  exit 1
fi

command:# Reports live under temporary-docs/gnomish/<task>/: the task branch's name without its
# gnomish/ prefix (the factory's own sanitized taskId), 'local' off a task branch.
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
change=$(sed -n 's/^Change:[[:space:]]*//p' $dir/change.md | head -1)
if ! out=$(scripts/check-merged-specs.sh "$change" 2>&1); then
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -40
  echo "scripts/check-merged-specs.sh: the merged main specs would not validate strictly - split the requirement in this change's delta, one behavior per requirement (.claude/rules/delta-specs.md); a failure in a spec this change does not touch is not this round's to fix - escalate through \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE naming it"
  exit 1
fi

command:# The change this task works on, named as the checks above name it.
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
change=$(sed -n 's/^Change:[[:space:]]*//p' temporary-docs/gnomish/$task/change.md | head -1)
if ! out=$(./gradlew -q checkSpecContract -PspecContractChanges=true -PspecContractChange="$change" 2>&1); then
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -40
  echo "the spec-contract check failed (file:line, rule and fix above; the whole list is build/reports/spec-contract.txt) - read .claude/rules/traceability.md, .claude/rules/delta-specs.md and .claude/rules/testing.md and fix each finding in the change's own artifacts; a finding outside them is not this round's to fix - escalate through \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE naming it"
  exit 1
fi

command:# Reports live under temporary-docs/gnomish/<task>/: the task branch's name without its
# gnomish/ prefix (the factory's own sanitized taskId), 'local' off a task branch.
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
change=$(sed -n 's/^Change:[[:space:]]*//p' $dir/change.md | head -1)
reports="$dir/change.md
$dir/review-artifacts.md
$dir/fix-artifacts.md"
stray() { grep -vxF "$reports" | grep -v "^openspec/changes/$change/" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true; }
dirty=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | sed 's/^...//' | stray)
if [ -n "$dirty" ]; then
  echo "this stage edits only openspec/changes/$change/ and writes $dir/fix-artifacts.md, but the working copy also carries:"
  echo "$dirty"
  echo "if you made these edits, undo each of them yourself and nothing else."
  echo "if you did not: they are someone else's work in progress. Leave every one of them exactly as it is - do not stash, restore, checkout or clean anything - and escalate through \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE naming the paths."
  exit 1
fi
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in
  gnomish/*)
    if base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD 2>/dev/null); then
      committed=$(git diff --name-only "$base" HEAD | stray)
      if [ -n "$committed" ]; then
        echo "the branch carries committed changes outside openspec/changes/$change/ and the stage reports:"
        echo "$committed"
        exit 1
      fi
    fi
    ;;
esac
